lean_source:
import ProofLab.Bridge

set_option maxHeartbeats 300000
theorem prooflab_result (α : Type) (A B : Set α) (hab : A ⊆ B) (hba : B ⊆ A) : A = B := by
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  assumption
  assumption

#prooflab_audit prooflab_result
